notes:
## What's new

- Added Mouse Tweaks, Easy Shulker Boxes, Status Effect Bars, Bookshelf Visualizer, Resourcify, Spatial GUI, Happy Ghast controls, Effortless Building and Block Shapes to the Right Shift menu across Minecraft 26.1, 26.1.2 and 26.3 on Fabric and NeoForge.
- Creative building tools and same-material block shapes remain Creative-only. Block Shapes now shows a vanilla-style selector: hold the shortcut, scroll, then release to choose.
- Spatial GUI settings now synchronize with its native settings, including first-/third-person behavior.
- Added Happy Ghast recall with an optional shortcut, host-controlled range and waiting time.
- Improved joining friends: reuse a compatible running game, show preparation/cancellation/retry controls, and avoid syncing inactive resource packs and shaders.
- Fixed title-screen version labels and duplicate button tooltips; removed unused launcher and game code while retaining the current interface.
- Fixed the OptiFine cape download path, failed-request caching, player-cache limit and local-skin composition. Cape fixes have been compiled but have not been visually tested with a cape-owning account.
- Native ports ship with their corresponding source, licenses and build instructions. Open Settings → About → Third-party licenses & source code.

## Update

Close Minecraft, then use Settings → Updates → Check for updates → Install and restart. Friends should update before using the new shared features. Profiles and worlds are stored separately from the application.

Downloads: macOS Apple Silicon (ARM64) and Windows x64. These remain testing builds, with macOS ad-hoc signing and no Apple notarization or Windows publisher certificate. There is no Intel Mac or Linux package in this release.

Earlier feature validation covered all six game/loader combinations and same-machine multiplayer. This release does not claim Windows gameplay, two-home networking or live cape-display validation.
